svg.title: Request lifecycle of the NL2SQL data engineering agent
svg.desc: Four entry surfaces converge on one authenticated request. A fixed YAML plan drives WorkflowRunner through parse_nl, schema_linking, generate_sql, validate_sql and execute_sql. Permission, constraint, SQL-policy and LLM-budget guard rails apply per step. Execution is conditional; a skipped or blocked run still produces an explicit status. Every surface shares one QueryResponse contract and a persisted trace.
